- After LEFT x5: cursor moved left, rows 19-20 had bbSS
- After RIGHT x10: cursor moved right, rows 19-20 had SSb
- After UP: cursor changed, rows 19-20 had bb/SS
Hmm, maybe the key is that the cursor needs to be at a specific position AND have a specific orientation. Let me try clicking now with the cursor at the right end with SSSS on bottom.
